村.memory: Trees and neatly measured plots make a village.
村.visual: A broad tree stands on the left. To its right, a hooked measuring post crosses a short beam, with a small marker dot just to the left of the hook. The boy measures a tiny village plot beneath the tree.

竹.memory: Two bamboo tips bend toward each other.
竹.visual: Two distinct upright bamboo sprigs side by side. Each has a short diagonal tip, a horizontal twig and a long downward stem. The right stem curls slightly at its foot. Keep the pair large, with the boy peeking through the gap.

森.memory: Three trees grow into a forest.
森.visual: Exactly three distinct 木-shaped trees, one centered high above two side by side below. Use staggered roots to keep the triangular shape unmistakable. The boy is tiny in the gap between the two lower trees.

林.memory: Two trees standing side by side make a grove.
林.visual: Exactly two distinct trees side by side on the same baseline, each with an upright trunk, a pair of broad boughs and flared roots reflecting 木. The boy explores between them. No other trees.

玉.memory: One precious gem is tucked against the bottom of three tiers.
玉.visual: Three stacked golden display rails joined by a straight central stem. Place a single conspicuous jade gem in the lower-right gap immediately above the bottom rail. The boy admires it from outside the rails.

虫.memory: A boxy bug sits on a stalk with a tiny tail dot.
虫.visual: Make a box-shaped beetle body with a vertical reed running through it and protruding above and below. Below, a low curved twig sweeps right under it. A tiny droplet sits at the right tip. The boy notices the insect through a small magnifier.

糸.memory: A folded thread ends in three dangling tips.
糸.visual: One thick red thread makes two clear angular bends, like a folded skein standing upright. Three separate loose ends fan out below: long middle, short diagonals either side. The mascot holds up the skein without obscuring it.

貝.memory: An upright shell has two inner ridges and two little feet.
貝.visual: A tall boxy seashell dominates, with two bold horizontal ridges inside. Two separate tapered shell tips splay outward at its base. The boy finds it at low tide. Show the shell from the front.

算.memory: Count the rows below bamboo, then work the answer out with your hands.
算.visual: Stack two little bamboo tips above a large vertical rectangular tally board with two horizontal inside bars. Under it, two upright toy levers rise through a single horizontal rail. The boy moves one tally. Preserve the three distinct tiers.

線.memory: A thread follows the line of a spring.
線.visual: At left is a folded red thread with three loose tips. At right a square pale stone spout sits directly above a blue flow that divides downward like 水. One thread follows the outline of the stream without masking either component.

門.memory: Two tall hinged leaves form a gate.
門.visual: One tall double gate viewed head-on, with two short rectangular panels at the top and long posts extending straight down the outer sides. A broad opening below the panels keeps the overall 門 silhouette. The boy peeks out from inside.

谷.memory: The slopes gather around a little opening in the valley.
parts: two pairs of slopes (八 and 人)
谷.visual: Two small slanting ridges at top point into a second larger pair of sloping ridges. A square cave opening sits directly underneath at the bottom center. A tiny boy stands just outside the opening. Make the stacked shapes easy to pick out.

細.memory: A fine thread runs beside the four plots of a field.
細.visual: A slim folded skein with three loose tips on the left, a square rice field split into exactly four plots on the right. The boy stretches a thin strand along the field edge. Use an almost top-down view for the square grid.

丸.memory: A curling shape hugs a round dot.
丸.visual: Two broad curved bands meet to form a large 九-like curling shape with a sweeping hooked foot. Tuck a single clearly separate round orange marble into the lower-left notch and let the boy reach toward it from one side.

戸.memory: A lintel and one sloping post frame a single door.
戸.visual: One broad lintel sits floating just above a small boxlike upper door leaf. A long curved support sweeps down-left from the upper door leaf. The boy pushes that door inward. Front-facing and simple silhouette.

羽.memory: Two hinged wings have a pair of feather marks each.
羽.visual: Two compact matching stylized wings sit side by side, each with a near-horizontal top and a vertical right edge with a tiny inward hook at its bottom. Two small feather marks slant inside each wing. The boy marvels below the pair.

岩.memory: A boulder lies below a three-peaked mountain.
岩.visual: Put a distinct three-peaked mountain with a common base directly above a broad slanting stone ledge and a square boulder under its right side. The boy leans against the square boulder. Keep mountain and stone as two stacked shapes.

角.memory: A hooked horn has a square base with three sharp divisions.
角.visual: One hooked golden horn tip bends across the top and tapers down to the left side of a stout rectangular horn base. Divide the base with one central upright and two horizontal grooves. The boy examines a sharp corner of the chunky shape. Make the horn a friendly carved toy.

池.memory: Three droplets feed a pond with a curled bank.
池.visual: Three separate droplets descend diagonally along the left. To the right a wide pond edge is shaped as a long curling bowl with two upright reeds crossing the top rim, one tall in the middle. The boy looks for a fish without hiding the curl.

星.memory: A bright square light shines above a growing sprout.
星.visual: A rounded square yellow light with a clear horizontal dividing mark floats above an upright sprout made of three stacked horizontal leaves crossing one stem. Keep both shapes centered and bold. The boy gazes upward from the side.

寺.memory: A measured post holds the temple platform.
寺.visual: A stacked platform with a central upright like 土 sits high. Below it, a lower bar crosses a hooked golden pillar with a single small marker dot to its left. Tiny temple visitor beside it.

弱.memory: Two soft bows droop side by side.
弱.visual: Two matching bent bows shaped like 弓 sit side by side, sagging toward their matching bases. Beneath the inner bend of each, two small pale slanted ribbons droop. Boy gently tests one slack string.

毛.memory: Three strokes of fur curl at their ends.
parts: short upper sweep and two lines
毛.visual: A big soft tuft with a slanting top strand, two horizontal strands, and one long center strand descending through them before curling up to the right. Boy brushes it from the edge.

黄.memory: A square yellow lantern glows on two little feet.
黄.visual: A saturated yellow lantern with a short crown made of two pegs crossed by a bar. Under it a thin rail, a centered square gridded body and two little splayed feet. Boy holds a yellow paint swatch off to the side.

雲.memory: Rain gathers over a curled cloud.
雲.visual: The upper half is a broad arch with a flat top, strong center upright and four drops inside. Below the roof are two short bands and a wide low curling white vapor trail. Boy watches from one side.

麦.memory: A barley stalk rises above its crossed roots.
麦.visual: Three short shelves of golden kernels cross one straight stem at the top. The lower stem bends left into a small zigzag before the two roots splay. Boy holds one harvested head off to the side.

区.memory: A district is marked by an X inside an open box.
区.visual: Show a map almost from above. A thick angular boundary holds the top, left and bottom edges, visibly open to the right. Inside it two contrasting paths cross diagonally in an X. Boy stands at the junction.

県.memory: A prefecture sign hangs over three paths.
県.visual: A tall map sign with two or three inside divisions, above a long hooked platform extending left. Three short paths fan out beneath the platform from its center. Boy points at the divisions; no map labels.

委.memory: The woman presents the grain for the committee.
委.visual: Top is a broad grain stalk whose boughs splay like 禾. Below it sits a woman whose crossed legs and extended arm fit the 女 silhouette. She passes the grain to a smaller mascot at the edge, keeping the two tiers clear.

島.memory: A bird perches on an island with three peaks.
島.visual: A front-view seabird crest and boxy wing dominate the top. Its outer body drops left and sweeps loosely to the right around a distinct three-peaked rocky island along the bottom. A little boy spots it from the edge.

農.memory: A divided seed tray sits over the farmer’s plough and furrows.
農.visual: A rectangular seed tray with one horizontal division and two upright dividers occupies the top. Below it a ledge sweeps down left, framing several long horizontal furrows and two outward root tracks. Boy tends the lower furrows.

州.memory: Three islands split the channels of a river.
州.visual: Use an overhead map. Across the frame the six large shapes alternate from left to right in this exact order: green sandbank, blue channel, green sandbank, blue channel, green sandbank, blue channel. Each sandbank is a short slanted dash beside the middle of its own tall channel. The first channel bends left at its foot. Tiny boy stands below the map and leaves the islands unobstructed.

階.memory: A terraced cliff puts everyone on a floor.
階.visual: Narrow stepped cliff fills the left. On the right two small matching standing friends perch above a single wide landing with a clear square window and middle line. Floor boundaries read clearly at card size.

橋.memory: Wood supports a high bridge with two openings.
橋.visual: Large 木-shaped tree at left. At right, a high curved deck with two arms sits above a small square opening, then a wider rectangular arch with a smaller opening centered inside. Boy crosses the lower bridge.

岸.memory: A mountain meets a cliff on the shore.
parts: left ledge and post (厂 and 干)
岸.visual: Three low peaks crest the top, above a rocky ledge that runs across then down the left. Under the ledge two horizontal dock beams cross one tall vertical post. Boy walks beside the bottom post at the shore.

央.memory: A figure stands right through the middle of a frame.
央.visual: One squat open-bottom frame in the middle, crossed by a bold rail halfway down. The boy is centered with both arms stretched along the rail and legs spread below; one small vertical fin rises above the frame.

根.memory: A tree stands beside a root bent like a boot.
根.visual: On the left show a 木-shaped tree above the ground. On the right build a squared upper stump with two horizontal bands. The bottom extends down into one angular foot and a long diagonal root sweeping to the right. Boy waters the tree.

鉄.memory: A metal block drops beside a stack of metal bars.
鉄.visual: At left a small triangular cap over stacked gold bars and two small ingots. At right a blue-gray iron beam across two bars, with a toy magnet shape above and supports splaying below. A small boy catches a falling iron bolt next to it.

短.memory: The short arrow stands beside a bean jar.
短.visual: A compact toy arrow frame on left, formed by a tilted top piece, two crossbars and two spread feet. To its right, a squat bean pot with a flat lid, square opening and wide foot. Boy measures how short the arrow is.

油.memory: Oil drips from a jar with a tall spout.
油.visual: Three large golden oil droplets on far left. On the right an upright square four-pane oil flask has a raised central pouring spout lined up with the vertical divider. Boy tips the flask only slightly so the square still reads.

植.memory: Plant the tree so it stands straight.
植.visual: A tree with crossed boughs and roots fills left. At right a tall planting stake carries a cap cross, a box with two horizontal divisions, and a strong horizontal foot. The boy steadies the stalk beside it.

倍.memory: One person hears a sound twice.
倍.visual: The boy forms a narrow, upright silhouette at left. At right a single two-tier object has a wide standalone top with two angled legs, stacked directly above one square speaker mouth. Two little echoes issue from the mouth.

波.memory: Water follows the folds of a skin.
波.visual: At left three separate blue droplets. At right the frozen curl of one broad wave resembles a draped sheet: wide hooked top, long upright through it, and two clearly crossed sweep lines below. Boy rides next to the curl.

練.memory: Repeating the thread pattern takes practice.
練.visual: A red folded skein and three tips on left. At right, a golden weaving board, top rail over narrow divided center, one upright crossing it and two loose diagonal ends down low. Boy practices weaving.

軽.memory: A little hand lifts a light wagon.
軽.visual: Left has a square thin wagon viewed from above with a tall axle passing through a rectangular divided body and two rail lines. Right has a crossed hand ribbon above one short pedestal shaped like 土. The boy easily lifts the light toy.

血.memory: A drop sits above a little tray.
血.visual: Use an abstract red bead, isolated above one broad shallow golden tray with three vertical slots. A flat base and open spaces between slots must read clearly at card size. Boy points toward the display. Educational diagram feel, a clean symbolic image.

温.memory: Water warms in a pan beneath the sun.
温.visual: At left three separate blue droplets. On the right stack a small square sun with a horizontal center mark directly above a distinct wide pan whose side has three vertical sections. Boy enjoys gentle warmth off to the side.

庫.memory: A cart is kept inside a roofed storehouse.
庫.visual: A large shelter forms a cap roof and a long left sweeping wall. Inside, position a top-view square divided wooden cart with cross rails and tall long axle extending above and below. The boy rolls it into storage.

坂.memory: The ground slopes under an overhanging ledge.
坂.visual: Put a narrow earth-shaped marker with one upright and two bars on left. Right holds a broad cap and downward-left buttress above a clear X made by two diagonal slopes. Boy slides only along the lower right slope.

板.memory: Wood and a tilted support make a plank.
板.visual: Large upright tree on left. Right has a plank forming a cap then slanting down-left just like an overhang. Below that two distinct angled timbers meet in an X. Boy holds the carpenter's plank with a peeking smile.

章.memory: An upright marker stands above an early sun.
章.visual: Three clearly separated levels: a squat standing cap with two supports and a wide lower rail, a square sun with a dividing line, and a short cross foot. Make a golden chapter marker the boy slots between pages. No lettering or book cover behind.

秒.memory: Grain drops one at a time as seconds pass.
秒.visual: Left is a tall grain sprig with crossed boughs. To its right a small vertical stalk with two separate side dots sits above a slashing down-left grain chute. Boy catches one grain in a cup, without obscuring the right silhouette.

皮.memory: A hide hangs from an upright peg and crosses at its folds.
皮.visual: One broad warm leather hide hangs from a horizontal beam with a right hook and a tall centered peg extending beyond it. Its left edge drops as a long slant and the two broad lower folds clearly cross before flaring outward. Boy holds a corner.

柱.memory: The main pillar beside a tree supports the roof.
柱.visual: A 木-shaped tree at left. At right one tall bold pavilion pillar crosses three wide beams above each other, with one distinct gold cap dot floating above. Boy tests its steadiness with both hands.

祭.memory: Hands lift an offering above the festival altar.
祭.visual: At top left a small wrapped offering with two fold marks. At top right two crossing open hands hold the offering. Beneath both, a wide altar with two rails, central leg and two short flared feet. The boy celebrates beside it.

筆.memory: Bamboo grips a brush with stacked bristles.
筆.visual: Top shows two separate bamboo tip accents. Directly below, a vertical brush handle crosses a rectangular stack of five short rails that look like layered bristles at its base. Boy writes a single little ink swoosh off to the side.

童.memory: A child stands above the divided floor.
童.visual: At top, a boy stands with feet wide atop a rail and a small top knob above his head, forming a compressed 立-like block. Below is a rectangular four-pane platform with a vertical center reaching down through two lower bars.

緑.memory: A thread draws color from a ladle of green dye.
緑.visual: Folded red skein on the left. At right a squared stepped scoop above a short vertical green dye stream and three drops fanning outward below. The boy dips one thread; keep the green dye and stepped scoop prominent.

荷.memory: Grassy cargo is carried by a person beside a hook.
荷.visual: At top two sprigs along a horizontal grass rail. Under it boy stands upright on the left, carrying a bold object on right formed by a long top rail, one right hook and a square box tucked inside. Keep both tiers separate.

炭.memory: Charcoal smolders under a mountain ledge.
parts: mountain and cliff (山 and 厂)
炭.visual: Three small mountain peaks on a shared line above a wide ledge curling down the left. Under it a single stylized orange flame rests on two black charcoal chunks, with two separate embers making the side marks. Boy watches from a safe distance.

湖.memory: An old moon hangs over water to make a lake.
湖.visual: Three blue droplets down the left. To the right a short post crosses a bar above a square opening, next to a tall pale moon lantern with two interior bars. Link their bases with a tiny lake bank and put the boy under the moon.

湯.memory: Sunlight sends steam over hot water.
湯.visual: Three droplets descend down left. On the right a square sun with center stripe sits above one broad horizontal ledge. Beneath it three short curving golden steam ribbons sweep left. Boy looks at his small cup beside the plume.

氷.memory: A frozen drop clings to the side of the water shape.
氷.visual: Build an icicle sculpture with a tall central hooked shard and broad sweeping blue wings on both sides, in the overall 水 silhouette. Add one separate short icy shard high and slightly left. Boy looks closely from the edge.

拾.memory: A hand picks up a box with a lid that fits.
拾.visual: At left a tall curved wooden hand shape with two short fingers crosses an implied wrist; put the boy reaching alongside it. At right a broad triangular lid sits over one small square box. The boy is picking up the box.

鼻.memory: A nose sits high above a divided mask and two feet.
鼻.visual: Top features a boxy stylized nose with one protruding curve at top and two short marks inside. Directly below sit a four-compartment square and a narrow rail with two legs dropping down. Boy peers around the side of the funny stacked nose mask.

皿.memory: A rectangular shallow dish sits on a flat base.
皿.visual: Front view of one shallow rectangular golden serving dish, flat top rim, two internal straight dividers, broad flat base extending beyond the sides. Small boy peers from its side. No extra cups.

協.memory: Three helpers pull together by a shared crossing post.
協.visual: Left is one broad cross-shaped wooden post. To the right three separate hooked pull levers are in a triangle (one high, two low); one slanting cord per lever. A small boy holds the low right cord.

改.memory: A hand turns an old curled piece into a new one.
改.visual: At left a squared wooden ribbon curls up from a low horizontal foot. To the right two hinged parts cross in a clear X beneath a small diagonal cap and one short bar. Boy turns a small handle at the edge.

府.memory: A person delivers a measured parcel under the office roof.
府.visual: Top eave with a little top knob and a long sloping left support wraps around two objects. Beneath: the boy upright on the inner left holds a parcel, beside a hooked post on inner right crossed by a rail with one small offset dot.

軍.memory: The column of wagons is kept under one canopy.
軍.visual: A broad squat cap roof above a large top-down wooden supply wagon, with a square split body and vertical axle extending up and down through two rails. Small chibi boy in ordinary outfit carries a supply flag beside it. Quiet scene.

各.memory: Each path ends at its own entrance.
各.visual: At top two broad narrow paths cross like a loose X with a short angled cap. Beneath center sits one square door, clearly separated from the paths. The boy chooses a path at the edge.

副.memory: A spare container waits next to the divider.
副.visual: Left is a tiny cap above the square neck of a tall amber pot, then a wider square four-pane base. At right are two narrow upright silver divider tabs, the taller one curling at its foot. Boy places a second small lid beside it.

象.memory: An elephant’s outline remembers its trunk and sweeping body.
象.visual: One side-view stylized elephant, with a small angular cap above a boxy head and central groove. Its body tapers into three parallel sweeps diagonally down-left. Set its raised hooked trunk at bottom right. Tiny boy at side for scale.

賞.memory: A shining stand presents a shell treasure as a prize.
賞.visual: A festival stand sits at upper center, one tall accent between two little side accents above a broad canopy and a square opening. Below it a shell prize with two bold interior lines and two detached splayed tips. Boy reaches for the shell.

辺.memory: A curved landmark sits beside the road.
辺.visual: A wide curled yellow sign with a sweeping inner diagonal stands upper right. A winding orange path, starting with a separate small stepping stone high on the left, wraps down around that sign and sweeps horizontally across the bottom. Boy walks along its edge.

低.memory: A person ducks beneath a bent low beam.
parts: bent beam and dot (氏 with dot)
低.visual: Put the boy left, with one shoulder-forward slant and a long straight outer leg. To the right a beam runs across and bends down into a long curling end, with a little separate gold marker below it. He checks how low the beam goes.

課.memory: Spoken directions explain how fruit grows.
課.visual: Make a compact tall column of word lines above one square speaker on left, without letters. On the right show a square fruit crate with four compartments above roots and boughs centered on its extending vertical trunk. Boy teaches from the margin.

極.memory: A tree stands beside the far end of a course.
極.visual: Left is a tall tree. On right a short flat cap with little hook leads into a center platform with small square opening at left and crossed ribbons at right, atop a broad flat bottom line. Boy marks the very end of the course.

量.memory: A marked window sits above a divided measuring bin.
量.visual: Top tier: rounded square window with one horizontal mark on a wide thin beam. Below, a four-pane box with its central upright continuing down through two horizontal platform bars. Boy counts rice portions next to the bin.

型.memory: A pattern presses its shape into the clay base.
型.visual: At top left, two straight uprights pass through two horizontal rails. A smaller vertical divider and taller hooked tab stand to their right. Center everything over a bold clay base made of two stacked bars and a short middle peg. Boy presses the mold.

史.memory: One hand pulls a line through a square record.
史.visual: Place a square wooden record frame high at center with one narrow upright that passes through and continues below. Under it two contrasting hands or paper strips sweep outward, the right strip long and low. The boy points at the record.

管.memory: A bamboo pipe leads through two stacked chambers.
管.visual: Two paired bamboo tips are at top. Below them, a small canopy goes over an upright pipe housing with a left vertical and two stacked rectangular openings of different widths. The boy listens from the edge to air flowing through it.

兵.memory: A soldier stands like a tall bracket on two planted feet.
兵.visual: One friendly toy soldier at rest. Build his upper silhouette from a wide slanted cap, two raised shoulders, a strong upright and straight waist bar. The two feet below splay apart with a generous gap. Keep the pose still and ceremonial.

録.memory: Metal holds a record as the ink flows.
録.visual: At left a triangular cap over stacked gold rails with two ingot corners. Right has a stepped square ink scoop that feeds a vertical ink flow with small diagonal marks on both sides. Boy stamps one small dot at the bottom; no text.

省.memory: A small lens hangs over a watchful eye.
省.visual: Top is an upright little lens handle between two separate small dots, with one sweeping diagonal reflection toward the left. Below it is an upright rectangular eye window with two dividing lines. Boy peers through from one edge.

周.memory: A boundary runs around a small courtyard.
周.visual: A tall U-shaped enclosure turned open downward wraps around an upright central sign and a square doorway below it. The mascot walks just inside one of the vertical edges. Keep square plan and empty room around the sign.

材.memory: A tree beside a hook becomes a beam.
材.visual: Put a 木-shaped tree on the left. At right one bold wooden beam with hooked vertical from top to bottom, one horizontal crossbar and a shorter slanting support sweeping to lower left. Boy stands between them holding a smooth board.

競.memory: Two runners race neck and neck.
競.visual: Two matching little racers face forward and fill the square side by side. Each has a small cap with a center knob, block-shaped shirt and two clearly separated angled legs. Use two distinct shirt colors. Keep their overall outlines parallel.

歴.memory: Footsteps of the past pass under a ledge and through two trees.
歴.visual: Big ledge across the top and sloping down the left encloses two short trees side by side above a wide-footed stair track with two upright supports. Boy follows one tiny footprint across the stair base.

航.memory: A boat follows the route marked by a tall buoy.
航.visual: Left is a long narrow overhead view of a little wooden boat with a prow cap, a short crossbeam and two center marks. Right is a navigation buoy with a top dot above a bar and two downward curling legs. Boy pilots the boat beside the buoy.

児.memory: A child peeks through two shapes on little legs.
児.visual: Stack a straight left post and a square window with a center stripe on top. The little boy peeks through the window with his smiling face. Beneath the upper shapes, two legs separate clearly, one straight diagonal and one curved hook to the right.

印.memory: A hand presses a stamp into a seal.
印.visual: A blocky hand on the left has an angled thumb and short horizontal finger. A tall golden stamp on the right has a square bent cap and one long straight drop. The boy is just about to press the stamp. The stamp stands upright on plain red wax with a completely smooth surface; no markings appear on the stamp or the wax.

輪.memory: A cart needs a wheel with an even pattern.
輪.visual: A square wagon body with axle and two bars at left. At right a roof-shaped hub cap over a round wheel with four vertical spoke sections, mounted on a golden stand. Boy fits the wheel onto the wagon. Keep both silhouettes visually distinct.

清.memory: Drops of clear water shine on a blue sprout.
清.visual: Three clear teal drops descend at left. At right a bright blue sprout made of three short horizontal shelves through one upright rests above a rectangular moon-blue window with two interior bars. Boy admires one droplet.

億.memory: A person imagines a huge number.
億.visual: Boy forms a narrow upright at far left. To the right a short tiered cap sits above one square window with a divider, and a large heart with tiny separated droplets at its sides sits below that. A few tiny stars inside its heart suggest an enormous thought. No numerals.

芸.memory: The craft brings together grass and a curled cloud.
芸.visual: A short stem of foliage runs across the top with two reeds. Below it two short horizontal gold rods sit above an airy puff curling to the left then back right. Boy shapes the cloud from a piece of clay.

停.memory: A person pauses beside a pavilion.
停.visual: Boy clearly left with one foot paused. On the right stack a cap with a little crown, a square opening, a broad shelter ledge, then a single clear bent post dangling below it. The building remains taller than the person.

陸.memory: Earthen terraces rise next to a cliff.
陸.visual: A slim mossy upright ridge at left, with two bumps at its top. At right two blocky earth ledges stack with an open pair of legs at center, above a low horizontal base; define each edge clearly. Boy steps onto solid land.

帯.memory: A broad belt sits above cloth hanging from its buckle.
帯.visual: Three small loops poke upward from one prominent horizontal golden belt. Directly beneath, a broad tan band covers a small hanging fabric rectangle with a single strong center seam extending down. Boy adjusts a buckle beside it.

固.memory: An old sign sits inside a firm square frame.
固.visual: A bold thick square outer frame contains a smaller centered upright sign, with a short cross directly above one square opening. Tiny boy knocks on the frame from the outside to test its strength. Keep the inner sign separate from the outer edges.

囲.memory: A heavy square fence surrounds a well.
囲.visual: Use one nearly frontal square enclosure. Inside stand two short uprights crossing two horizontal rails like a井-grid. Boy peers across one outer fence edge. Separate interior pattern from enclosure with a generous gap.

卒.memory: Two graduates stand above a crossed post.
parts: cap and pair (亠 and two 人)
卒.visual: Top has a small cap and two little graduates with splayed legs side by side underneath. An oversized cross-shaped plinth anchors the scene below. Keep the tall stroke and crossbar visible and centered.

順.memory: A row of three streams follows a page.
順.visual: At left three long aligned ribbons show the river paths, outer left slightly curved. At right a framed page stands above two tiny angled feet. A small top tag and two page dividers read at card size. The boy follows the streams.

令.memory: An instruction comes down from under the roof.
令.visual: Two broad slopes form a peaked roof. Center a distinct dot directly below its peak, then a short horizontal bar and a bent downward seal like a folded ribbon below that. Boy reads the symbolic seal, with no written words.

貨.memory: A changed pair of shapes sits above a shell full of goods.
貨.visual: Top left a standing child; top right another in a turning pose with a broad hook swept by a scarf below. Below both a boxy shell basket with two bands and two detached feet. Show goods such as a tiny wrapped parcel inside the shell, preserving the shell outline.

季.memory: A child watches the grain change with the season.
季.visual: Overhead a large grain stalk with central upright and crossed boughs. Directly below a boy’s bent body and straight outstretched arms make a hook crossed by a long horizontal line. Tie one golden seasonal ribbon to the upper stalk.

底.memory: A heavy hooked beam sits at the bottom of a shelter.
底.visual: A short top knob and long eave fold down into the left support. Below and to the right, a horizontal brown beam swerves into a curved foot, with one distinct small pebble below its lowest part. Boy points to the pebble.

希.memory: A cross above hanging cloth makes a wish flag.
希.visual: Two thin crossing beams float at top. Beneath them one short rail has a long right-dangling cloth with central seam and a left slanting support. Boy ties a small golden charm to the cloth. Keep the cross above visibly distinct.

仲.memory: A person stands beside a post straight through the middle.
仲.visual: Boy stands on the left, narrow body with one slanted shoulder. At right, one strong upright passes through the very center of a single square window and extends above and below. He passes a small parcel through the opening.

栄.memory: A tree flourishes beneath a bright shelter.
栄.visual: Arrange three well-separated glints over a broad low cover. Directly below, a magnificent tree with one tall straight trunk, horizontal branches and two splaying roots fills most of the picture. Boy waters the tree from the side.

札.memory: A tree holds a dangling wooden tag.
札.visual: Large 木 tree left. At right a single narrow vertical tag curves smoothly into a long upward hook at the bottom. A little ribbon connects the top of the tag to a tree branch while leaving open space between the shapes. Boy reaches for the blank tag.

包.memory: A curved wrapper folds around a curled parcel.
包.visual: One large bright wrapper begins high at left, goes across the top and bends down on the right with a visible curved tip. Inside, one smaller squared ribbon folds twice and curls up at its right foot. Boy pulls a corner to wrap it.

焼.memory: Fire bakes a stack on two feet.
焼.visual: At left a simple flame with two separated sparks and two splayed lower tips. At right an upright kiln with three horizontal shelves and two splayed feet under the lowest shelf. Boy checks a small loaf visible on the middle shelf.

照.memory: A sun and a lamp call light down onto four embers.
照.visual: At top left a square sun with a dividing line. To its right a bent lamp top above one square glass opening. Directly below both make exactly four separate evenly spaced glowing orange drops. Small boy admires the light from the edge.

漁.memory: Water droplets lead to a fish with a gridded body and a fan of dots.
漁.visual: Three drops down the left. On the right a front-facing stylized fish has a hooked top head, square body divided into four panes, and four small fin marks evenly aligned below. Tiny boy holds a fishing line to its side.

貯.memory: The shell holds savings beside a roofed hook.
貯.visual: At left a boxy upright shell has two distinct inner bars and two splayed feet. At right a small roof covers an isolated horizontal rail and hooked upright. Boy saves a little bead inside the shell.

訓.memory: Spoken instructions flow in three clear lines.
訓.visual: Put a stack of three short speech bars under a dot and above a square mouth on left. At right exactly three vertical blue channels descend side by side. Boy points through them in sequence. No written letters.

浴.memory: Three drops lead down to the bath in the valley.
浴.visual: Three bright water drops at left. On the right two small slanting rocks above two wider slanting slopes lead down into a clearly square stone bath. Boy sits beside the bath with a folded towel. Keep all valleys and the square visible.

塩.memory: Salt dries on a dish beside a patch of earth.
塩.visual: A simple cross and bottom base of earth on left. Right upper tier has a slanted scoop and small square mouth beneath a short ledge. Right bottom tier is a wider squared shallow pan with three vertical sections full of white crystals. Boy fills a tiny scoop.

兆.memory: Two halves of a sign open with marks on each side.
兆.visual: Two tall ochre strokes near center bend away from each other at the bottom, one to each side. Two clearly separate short slanted sparks flank each side, four total. Boy gazes at this simple omen sign from a corner.

祝.memory: A person beside a little altar offers congratulations.
祝.visual: At far left a narrow ceremonial stand with a top dot and short crossed members. At right a bold square mouth opening above two splayed feet belongs to a friendly festival puppet. Boy ties one festive ribbon to the stand.

衣.memory: A collar opens into long folds of cloth.
衣.visual: A single golden clasp dot centers over a straight shoulder rail. Two front folds of a coat slope down across each other, with a long right fold and a smaller upward left hem. Boy stands behind the garment with only his head visible.

臣.memory: A tall panel with a watchful eye stands at attention.
臣.visual: One tall rectangular costume shield with a clean continuous left upright. Within it, two short bars extend to the right and one square eye is tucked into the middle. Boy stands respectfully by it as an attendant.

浅.memory: A few long ripples cross shallow water.
浅.visual: Three separate water drops on far left. On the right a narrow diagonal reed and its tiny separate upper dot cross two long horizontal shallow water lines. Boy wades beside the lower line with visible shoes on the streambed.

勇.memory: Courage moves a heavy tunnel gate.
勇.visual: At top a small angular cap above a square divided tunnel-gate frame with an extended central handle. Below it, a broad hooked lever and one diagonal support. Boy gathers courage and pulls the lever to open it.

械.memory: A wooden machine has a crossbar and lever.
械.visual: A tall 木 tree on the left. On the right a simple wooden machine with a horizontal crossbar, two small standing supports and a long diagonal hooked lever sweeping to the right with a tiny marker above. Boy tests the hand lever.

菜.memory: A hand picks a vegetable under the leaves.
菜.visual: A low grass rail with two leaf stems across the top. Below, a flattened open hand and three small fingers hover over a large upright vegetable with branching shoulders and splayed roots. Boy gathers it from the side.

刷.memory: A brush stamps the cloth inside a shelter.
刷.visual: A roof with a left sweep encloses a three-part cloth hanging down on center left. Two tall narrow brush handles stand on the right, the taller with a curled foot. Boy uses one brush to print a single star on the cloth.

孫.memory: A child holds a ribbon that runs down the generations.
孫.visual: At left a tiny boy stands with one long arm at shoulder height, a curved leg below and a small cap above. On the right one short diagonal stroke sits over a broad knot of thread with three dangling tips. Boy takes one end of the family ribbon.

毒.memory: A strange plant grows above a crossed warning bottle.
毒.visual: At top show a stylized prickly stem through three rails. Beneath it a large tilted squared bottle crosses a horizontal strip, with two large round spots inside. Small boy points to the bottle from outside the composition. No liquid being used.

粉.memory: Grains are divided into tiny powder.
粉.visual: On the left rice grains fan from one upright like a star. On right two diagonals splay high above a squared crank with one curving lower arm. Boy turns the little mill to make a neat mound of flour at the lower right.

灯.memory: A flame hangs beside a straight hooked stand.
灯.visual: One rounded stylized flame with a central tongue and two side sparks at left, and an oversized horizontal rod with a long hooked vertical at right. Boy watches the flame glowing beside the stand.

胃.memory: A divided food tray goes into a pouch.
胃.visual: Top is a four-pane square food tray, frontal and large. Directly beneath it one narrow rounded pouch with two horizontal marks opens upward, hinting at a full stomach. Boy pats his shirt next to the display.

総.memory: Tie all the threads into one bundle at the heart.
総.visual: At left a red folded skein with three downward tips. On the right two short outward slants frame a single folded tie, all above one large heart with flanking little dots. Boy ties the skein to the bundle.

領.memory: A seal defines the territory on a page.
領.visual: Left is a sloping little roof over an isolated dot and bent seal ribbon. To its right a tall rigid map page has one top tag, two inner horizontal bars and two detached splayed feet. Boy seals a boundary without covering either shape.

設.memory: Spoken directions set a stand in place.
設.visual: At left show a few short speech bars descending to a square speaker opening. At right two compact bent upright supports sit above an X made of crossing golden straps. Boy follows the directions and sets up the stand.

査.memory: Inspect the tree while it stands on its growing tray.
査.visual: Stack one large 木 tree directly atop a tall rectangular planter. Three bold horizontal lines divide the planter, with a broad straight foot extending beyond both sides. Boy inspects one root next to the square.

団.memory: A group gathers around a measure inside the square.
団.visual: Bold square outward boundary surrounds a central hooked post crossed by a wide rail with one short circular marker to its lower left. Tiny children gather around the inside edge as a group, leaving the post and dot visible.

勢.memory: Stacked earth presses down onto a strong lever.
勢.visual: At top arrange an earth shelf at left and one curved weight on the right linked by a short rail, all stacked over a large bent diagonal lifting lever with a hooked foot. Boy pushes the lower lever with both hands.

減.memory: The water retreats beside a half-covered box.
減.visual: Three water beads descend along the far left in decreasing sizes. Right shows a long ledge and slanted outer leg, a short crossbar above a square opening inside, and a curling diagonal trailing right. Boy watches one little water level drop.

再.memory: A divided frame repeats a horizontal stroke.
再.visual: A thin golden rail spans the top. Below it place a boxlike open-bottom frame with two horizontal interior lines, a center upright and a broad horizontal foot. Boy stacks one repeated wooden shelf into the frame.

税.memory: A part of the harvest passes through the tax gate.
税.visual: Left is a grain stem with a drooping cluster at its upper left, crossing branch and roots. At right two short slants sit above a square gate mouth with two distinct splayed feet. Boy gives one small grain sack to the gate.

営.memory: Two rooms operate beneath one covered entrance.
営.visual: Above a broad cover, place three small roof rays. Below it stand two stacked squared service windows, the upper smaller and the lower wider. Boy opens the lower one to run a little stall.

比.memory: Two curled figures stand side by side to be compared.
比.visual: Two matching brown-haired mascots stand side by side, each leaning slightly forward with one bent leg ending in a foot curling right. Give the left child a clear short horizontal arm line and the right child a slanted raised arm. Keep both profiles visible.

防.memory: A flag guards the side of the hill.
防.visual: Left is a narrow green ridge with two bumps. Right a small gold flag finial sits above a broad rail and a long hooked banner support with a slant sweeping toward lower left. Boy stands beside the post as a lookout.

境.memory: A bright marker marks the end of the ground.
境.visual: A short earthen cross stands at left. At right a tall marker has a roof cap above a square sunrise window and two long splayed feet at the bottom. Boy traces the boundary between them.

導.memory: A path and its marker lead down to a guiding hand.
導.visual: Upper right has a rectangular head marker with two interior lines and two short rays above its cap. A low winding path comes from the top left and wraps under the marker. A broad hooked measuring post with a small dot sits directly beneath the whole top scene. Boy guides from the edge.

輸.memory: A cart carries goods beside a covered loading stand.
parts: cover over stacked cargo and posts (俞)
輸.visual: At left a rectangular heavily lined wagon with central vertical axle. At right a triangular cover shelters a narrow two-shelf loading rack and two slim vertical posts. Boy wheels a small box toward it.

述.memory: A traveler follows the path past a marked tree.
述.visual: Upper right is a simple bold tree with crossed branches, a central stem, two angled roots and a single floating marker dot above its right branch. A curved path starts at one left stepping stone and sweeps across the bottom. Boy describes what he saw with a pointing gesture.

武.memory: A steady footstep stands inside a bent practice frame.
武.visual: A golden toy training frame has two thin horizontal rails and a long curved upright sweeping down to the right, ending in a hook. Tuck a small stepped foot platform at lower left. Boy practices a balanced stance on it. Entire picture peaceful and simple.

額.memory: A visitor’s face is framed beside a head.
額.visual: Left has a small roof and below it two crossed ribbons over a small square doorway. Right is a tall head portrait with a wide forehead marked by a soft golden light, an outline with two short divisions, and two tiny splayed supports below. Boy touches his forehead beside it.

準.memory: Water and a bird stand above the standard cross.
準.visual: Upper left shows three blue drops, upper right a tall squat bird with three straight wing bars. Directly below both rises one broad centered cross-shaped starting marker. The boy points to the cross as the common level.

造.memory: A path leads past a sign for what we make.
造.visual: At upper right a short angled stroke and two narrow bars cross a stem above a square opening. At left and below a winding orange workshop path wraps around the sign. Boy brings a small freshly made block along the path.

技.memory: A skillful hand fits two crossed pieces under a post.
技.visual: Left is a tall handlike hook with two short wrist rails. At right a bold cross-shaped wooden support above two curved interlocking pieces in a loose X. Boy fits them together carefully.

復.memory: A traveler repeats the steps around the same spot.
復.visual: Boy stands narrow at left with two small downward tracking marks behind him. On the right one short diagonal and bar top a square divided sun above two crossing curved footsteps. Show one fine curved direction ribbon leading back under the sun.

移.memory: A grain stalk moves past two crescents.
移.visual: Put a stylized golden grain stem at left. On right two bold crescent ribbons stack diagonally, second lower and slightly right, with one distinct inside dash each. Boy moves one of them nearer the stalk.

個.memory: One person stands beside their own square space.
個.visual: Left show one boy in a straight upright pose. At right one thick square frame surrounds a simple cross above one square opening like a personal cubby. Boy puts one leaf inside. Preserve the clear separation between person and box.

接.memory: A hand reaches out and joins a figure under a stand.
接.visual: Far left a tall curved hand silhouette with clear wrist and two short rails. To the right, a small pegged stand sits directly above a woman posed with crossed legs and outstretched arm. Her hand connects to the left fingertips over a visible gap.

効.memory: Crossed parts set a lever in motion.
効.visual: On left a small top dot and beam hover over two narrow ribbons that converge then cross at bottom. To the right one bold bent golden lever has one diagonal supporting leg and a curled foot. Boy pushes the lever and the little crossed ribbons turn.

旧.memory: An upright marks off an old familiar date.
旧.visual: One tall straight weathered post on left, one larger square old calendar tile on right split by a clean horizontal bar. No numerals. Boy dusts off the lower tile without covering the bar.

券.memory: A paper arch holds the ticket punch.
券.visual: Place two short tilted marks above two horizontal ledges whose lower supports spread. Directly beneath, a curled ticket strip has a squared top, hooked right edge and one slanted inner fold. The boy collects it.

編.memory: Thread binds the pages inside a single cover.
編.visual: Left is a tall folded skein with three loose tips. Right is a sloping roof of a book cover above a square page grid with strong upright divisions. A little boy threads the binding.

採.memory: A hand picks from a tree beneath reaching fingers.
採.visual: Left is a tall hand and wrist with two fingers projecting right. On the right, a small hand with several fingers hovers directly above a broad 木-shaped tree. The mascot reaches for a small fruit.

貿.memory: Two traders meet over a shell full of goods.
貿.visual: Make two distinct upright curled ribbons face each other on top as two trading stalls. Center a boxy shell with two bold inner bars and two splayed feet beneath, holding one tiny parcel.

講.memory: Spoken words introduce a neatly stacked display.
講.visual: At left put speech marks over one square speaker. At right show a rack with rods projecting above two rails, over a square lower box whose central upright and crossbar remain visible. The boy explains the rack.

河.memory: Three drops lead to a hooked river gate.
河.visual: On the left three separate blue drops. On the right one long gold top beam turns down at the far right into a deep hook. Put a square water opening below the beam, just left of the hook; the boy watches the flow.

禁.memory: Two trees stand over a sign marking a closed grove.
禁.visual: Exactly two matched trees on top, side by side. Center a warning stand below: two horizontal beams and three narrow supports, long in the middle. The mascot gently holds up a palm beside the stand.

逆.memory: The road loops past a sign turned the other way.
逆.visual: On right an upright rail and twin slanted marks stand above a bold three-prong bracket with the middle prong extending below. A small path dot at top left and a broad curved road sweep around the left and bottom. Boy turns to walk back.

久.memory: One long bending trail keeps going after a short one ends.
久.visual: Make one brief diagonal wedge at top, then a thick ribbon starting flat before bending down-left. A second ribbon crosses and extends far below to the right. The mascot slowly follows its footprints.

暴.memory: The sun bursts above a platform and scattered sparks.
暴.visual: Stack a divided square sun, a rail crossing two upright pegs, then a fan of separated blue and orange sparks around one center drop. A tiny surprised boy stands on the side; make it a cheerful magic show.

均.memory: A small balance keeps the earth level.
均.visual: A tan cross over a straight earth base on left. At right a curved top and long right edge curl around two short diagonal weights spaced evenly inside. The boy checks their balance.

圧.memory: A heavy ledge presses the earth under it.
圧.visual: One heavy square stone ledge crosses the top then slopes down the left, open on the right. Beneath it a raised central peg spans two broad earth lines and visibly supports the load. Boy presses a tiny scale at the edge.

則.memory: The shell keeps beside two straight measuring rules.
則.visual: A tall square seashell with two clear inner bars and two separated feet at left. On the right two slim upright silver ruler strips, the taller curling slightly inward at its base. Boy lines them up.

測.memory: Three drops lead to a shell and upright depth gauge.
測.visual: Across the picture show three droplets on far left, a rectangular shell with two interior bars and two splayed feet in the middle, then two slim measuring rods on far right. The boy checks a tiny water level beside the rods.

豊.memory: A divided tray of food rests above a full serving dish.
豊.visual: Top tray is square with a horizontal divider and two uprights that extend above its rim. Below it a golden vessel has one square opening, two little diagonal supports and a flat broad foot. Boy adds one piece of food to the tray.

厚.memory: A child sits beneath a thick cliff and a square window.
parts: sun and child (日 and 子)
厚.visual: A bulky cliff ledge runs across the top then sweeps down the left. Under the cliff place a divided square light above the boy's outstretched horizontal arms and a curled lower leg. Keep the tiers centered under the cliff.

略.memory: A short route passes the doorway beside a field.
略.visual: Left: a square field with exactly four plots. Right: two crossed path ribbons beneath a tiny angled cap over one clear square doorway. The boy takes the shortcut on the right.

承.memory: Outstretched arms receive something between three rails.
承.visual: Center a long bent golden post crossed by exactly three short shelves. Two sweeping arms slope outward from its lower half, palms open. Tiny boy receives a parcel at the side.

版.memory: A wooden printing plate leans beside its crossed press.
版.visual: Left is a narrow upright printing plate with a distinctive bent foot and raised short bar. Right has a wide top ledge descending left above two diagonal blocks crossing underneath. The boy rolls ink on the plate.

損.memory: A hand discovers a cracked shell purse.
損.visual: A tall hand shape at left reaches right. On the right stack one square box over a larger ribbed shell purse with two feet. Include one subtle crack in the purse and a coin beside it to show a loss.

仏.memory: A quiet figure stands beside a small angular knot.
仏.visual: One calm child figure at left stands with a long vertical leg and slanted shoulder. At right a large angular golden loop fits into two angled sides and a flat low sweep, with a short final tail. Gentle temple mood in the objects only.

績.memory: Thread ties a carefully earned shell trophy.
績.visual: Left folded red thread with three loose tails. Right put three short bars crossed by one upright above a tall shell trophy with two bands and two little feet. Boy fastens a ribbon to the trophy without obscuring the stacked shape.

築.memory: A builder stacks bamboo and a frame on wood.
築.visual: Two bamboo accents at top, then a simple pair of brace posts in a short middle tier, then a large 木-like tree or wooden base with branching arms and feet. The boy adds a small piece to the brace.

混.memory: Water blends two matching curved scoops under a light.
混.visual: Three blue drops form a clear left column. On right a square lamp with one central stripe sits over two side-by-side curved scoop handles. Boy stirs where the scoops meet.

永.memory: A drop feeds a stream flowing on and on.
永.visual: A single small blue dot floats over a tall hooked stream stem. Two separate branch streams sweep hard left and right, each narrow at the start. The boy looks at the long flow from one side.

刊.memory: A printed sign sits next to two upright press bars.
刊.visual: At left two horizontal bars cross one strong upright, with clear space between the bars. Two slim upright press levers stand on the right, one tall with a slight hooked foot. A boy sets a blank card on the crossbar.

像.memory: A person admires a statue in the shape of an elephant.
像.visual: At left the mascot stands narrow and tall. At right a much larger wooden elephant statue with a cap, boxy head, several curved body bands and an upturned trunk. Keep a small gap between boy and elephant.

布.memory: Cloth hangs from a wide pole with a slanted prop.
布.visual: One wide horizontal wooden beam crosses a diagonal pole slanting down to the left. Below the right half hangs a square piece of cloth folded into three vertical sections, its center seam extending down. Boy ties a tiny knot to the beam.

複.memory: A spare garment is made by repeating the pattern.
複.visual: At left a slim robe on a hook forms a narrow column, with two sleeve marks. At right stack a little angled cap, a square divided shape and two crossed ribbon ends. Boy compares two tiny identical stitch swatches beside the pattern.

燃.memory: A flame warms a stack with four glowing embers underneath.
燃.visual: One stylized orange flame with two detached sparks at left. Right shows a small angled bundle and a friendly paw silhouette side by side, above exactly four orange embers. The mascot tends the campfire from the far edge.

預.memory: An angled hook saves a receipt on a tall page.
預.visual: Left build two short angular bends over one straight hanging hook and horizontal ledge. On right place a page with a short cap, two inner lines and two splayed feet. Boy tucks a gold token beside the page.

群.memory: The leader calls a sheep to join the flock.
群.visual: On left a bent top rail crosses two short shelves and one slant over a square mouth. On right two little horns crest three horizontal rails crossed by one upright, arranged as a cheerful sheep. Boy points to the flock.

快.memory: A heart lifts as a figure throws their arms wide.
快.visual: On left a slim red heart stem with two separate marks. On right a bent frame meets a strong horizontal bar, then opens into two sweeping legs. Boy smiles inside the open fork to link it to joy.

液.memory: Drops flow through a vessel beneath a night roof.
液.visual: Three drops at left. On right a short dotted cap stands above a slim figure and a bent curving pipe side by side. A clear little liquid stream falls through the pipe; don't fill the spaces around the shapes.

鉱.memory: Metal is found in a sheltered mine.
鉱.visual: At left a triangular cap tops short gold rails and two side ingots. At right a tall roof covers the top and left edges of a single angular inward curl of mineral. Boy holds a pebble off to the side.

枝.memory: A tree stands beside a branch with crossed twigs.
枝.visual: A broad 木-like tree on the left. On the right one small cross-shaped upright sits above two separately colored branch ends in a bold X. Boy fits a loose twig to one of the crossing branches.

綿.memory: Cotton thread hangs as white cloth.
綿.visual: Left folded skein and three free ends. Right a white square tag with one middle bar and small angled corner sits directly atop hanging white cloth with a descending center seam. Boy pulls a tiny cotton strand free.

銅.memory: A copper tile fits into a covered metal frame.
銅.visual: Left triangular roof over stacked gold bars and tiny side ingots. Right tall copper casing open at bottom with one short horizontal bar and one square opening inside. Boy polishes the casing.

耕.memory: A rake works the plot between crossed field rails.
耕.visual: At left one central rake shaft crosses several short rails and ends in two splayed tines. At right two uprights cross two horizontal field markers in a well grid. Boy drags the rake beside the grid.

党.memory: Friends gather beneath a hall canopy.
党.visual: Stack three upper rays over a wide canopy and a square hall opening. Two large feet curve outward below the opening. Boy waves to a tiny friend from one side of the hall.

革.memory: Three bands hold a hide stretched across a frame.
革.visual: Two pegs cross a wide rail at top. Below, a square tan hide hangs taut around a center strip with a cross foot extending down. Boy tests one corner.

補.memory: A spare patch mends the robe.
補.visual: Slim coat with angled sleeve marks left. On right place a framed patch split by two horizontal bars and one central upright continuing above its rim, with one small dot high on the right. Boy holds a stitch to one edge.

域.memory: A marker encloses a small piece of land.
域.visual: Earthen post and foot on left. At right a long tilted hook and crossed rail shelter a single square plot with a low short base, plus one tiny mark by the hook. Boy traces a boundary outside.

担.memory: A hand raises a square load above the ground.
担.visual: On left a slim upright hand with two fingers. To its right a square parcel with a center seam hovers immediately above a long straight baseline. The boy balances the load on his shoulder at the edge.

脳.memory: The body holds a thought inside a three-spark frame.
parts: three marks over crossed enclosure (悩 right)
脳.visual: Tall pale blue body panel at left with two inner bars. At right three detached thinking sparks crest an open-top U frame holding a bold crossed ribbon. Boy’s face peeks beside the frame.

蔵.memory: Grass covers a large low treasure store.
蔵.visual: Two grass tufts on top. Below, a wide shelter with a splayed left support and hooked right diagonal wraps a squared chest with a narrow center compartment. Boy pushes one small bundle inside.

針.memory: A shiny metal needle crosses a thread.
針.visual: An angular golden cap above stack of ingots on left. On right one single upright silver sewing needle crosses a strong horizontal red thread near midheight. A small boy threads it without hiding the cross.

専.memory: A precise tool measures a particular compartment.
専.visual: Top rectangular divided rack has one straight stem projecting above it and cutting through two inner bars. Below it a longer rail crosses a downward hook, with one small dot on the bottom left. Boy sorts a specific tool at the side.

並.memory: Two stacks stand neatly on one long line.
並.visual: Two separate short slanted tips at top over a broad rail. Under it two tall shelves with their side pegs face outward. Both sit on one broad bottom rail. Boy aligns them side by side.

将.memory: A banner and measuring hand show where to lead.
将.visual: Make a long thin left banner post with two side rails. At right three small fingertip marks sit above a hooked post crossed by a rail and one dot. Mascot grips the left banner and points right.

装.memory: A strong upper clasp holds clothing beneath.
装.visual: Upper tier: upright armor rail left and wide crossed clasp on right. Bottom: one robe with crossed drapes and splayed hems. Boy puts on the robe from behind.

諸.memory: Speech lists several things the maker shows.
諸.visual: At left three speech bars and one square mouth. At right a cap crossed by a long diagonal sits above a divided square display box. Boy points to three tiny objects in the box.

劇.memory: A stage beast performs beside two theater curtains.
劇.visual: Left a playful striped puppet crouches under a hooked left canopy, with sweeping ribbon legs. At right two clear vertical hanging curtains, tallest with a curl. Boy directs the puppet show.

署.memory: A four-pane panel hangs over a signed record.
署.visual: A wide shallow grid of four panes across the top. Beneath it a slanted flourish crosses short rails above a square record tile divided by one line. Boy places a small seal beside it, with no text.

延.memory: A long path stretches past a stepped marker.
延.visual: An angled top beam and stepped platform stand at upper right with a strong center upright. From top left one continuous copper path descends, curves and extends far across the bottom. Boy follows the long route.

乱.memory: A tongue speaks while a loose ribbon twists away.
乱.visual: On left a short angled cap crosses a post above a square puppet mouth. To the right a thick disordered ribbon starts upright then ends in a clear curling hook. Boy catches one loose end.

庁.memory: A sign hook hangs beneath the office roof.
庁.visual: A small top knob crowns a wide roof whose left wall sweeps down. Inside and right a horizontal desk sign rail forms a single long descending hook. Boy delivers a blank letter.

城.memory: Earth stands beside a castle with a curved outer wall.
城.visual: Earth cross at left. Right has a sturdy top ledge and left sloping support, with a short gate piece inside and a longer diagonal hooked wall sweeping up right. A lone gold pennant marks the upper corner.

層.memory: Shelves stack under a low slanting ceiling.
層.visual: Top and left form one broad overhang. Under it show two tiny slanted vents, a square four-pane box, and a smaller divided box below. Boy stacks one board beside the tiers.

裏.memory: The inside of a robe has a four-pane lining.
裏.visual: A small collar and wide shoulder rail top a clear square divided lining. Below the lining two broad folds slope away from each other. Boy flips a corner to show the reverse.

著.visual: Two grass accents above a short shelf. Below it a broad diagonal crossing a short post sits above a square divided display tile. Boy shows the finished tile to a small friend.

誌.memory: Spoken words are remembered in the heart of a journal.
誌.visual: Left stack three simple speaking bars above a square mouth. At right a short cross on a foot stands over a red heart and small side marks. Boy opens a little notebook off to one side.

宇.memory: A roof overhangs a large curved post.
宇.visual: A broad roof with a small center nub spans the top. Beneath it a long central bent post runs through two horizontal rails and curls at its foot. Boy peers up from beneath one eave.

枚.memory: A tree yields one flat board when tapped.
枚.visual: Large 木 silhouette on left. Right is a short leaning cap and rail above two crossing press arms. Boy lifts one thin plank from the press.

郵.memory: Mail falls through a tiered box beside a gate.
郵.visual: Left is a tall mail chute formed by four horizontal tiers crossing one shaft. Right is a narrow post with a rounded hook at top. Boy slides a tiny envelope into the chute.

骨.memory: A bony cap sits above a ribbed body panel.
骨.visual: Top has a squared notch and broad overhanging edge, like a cartoon bone joint. Beneath, a tall pale rounded rectangle contains two short inner bars like ribs. Boy examines it through a magnifier.

届.memory: A package waits inside an open shelter.
届.visual: The shelter runs across the top and down the left edge, open to front and right. A square parcel with four sections and an upright handle sits just inside; boy sets it at the entrance.

巻.memory: A tied cover opens into a curled scroll.
巻.visual: Stack two short angled pegs and two wide rails above a large curled parchment bottom. The inner curl makes one clear squared fold and an open hook. Boy unwinds the bottom edge.

簡.memory: Bamboo above a gate frames a single sun tile.
簡.visual: Two distinct bamboo groups atop a gate with two exposed outer posts and upper panels. Center one square sun with a center stripe inside the gate. Boy points to the simple middle shape.

臓.memory: A body panel sits beside a hidden storage chest.
臓.visual: Left make a narrow ribbed body panel, slender and two barred. At right two grass accents top a shelving hut with a diagonally hooked wall and a little chest inside. Boy opens a panel; playful model anatomy.

律.memory: Steps follow a brush with evenly spaced beats.
律.visual: Two angled steps and a post at left near the boy. At right a straight golden brush crosses five clear horizontal stripes. The boy taps out a rhythm on the stripes.

純.memory: A thread passes beside one clean, curled peg.
純.visual: Left is a knotted thread with three dangling tips. Right a straight cap and broad center beam meet a single curling branch with a low sweeping hook. Boy displays a clean pale thread sample.

翌.memory: Twin wings rest over an upright day marker.
翌.visual: Top shows two matched folded wings with two inside marks each. Below them a small crowned stand has a short rail, two angled supports and a long level foot. Boy turns the stand to face sunrise.

片.memory: One thin piece has a notch and a single foot.
片.visual: One tall wooden piece with a straight upper left edge that bends diagonally down-left. A short top-right bar and a long lower ledge with an upright right foot show the profile. Boy carries it carefully.

敬.memory: A guest bows by a small flower-covered offering.
敬.visual: At left a short grass rail sits over a curved cover around one square offering. At right a tilted twig and cap stand over two crossing arms. The boy bows between the components without obscuring them.

泉.memory: A pale square stone sends water branching downward.
泉.visual: Center a boxy white stone with a short diagonal crest and one inner stripe directly above a broad blue flow. One central jet drops into two angled streams and a curled stem. Boy scoops a tiny cup at the margin.

宝.memory: A roof protects a little gem on a tiered stand.
宝.visual: A simple roof spans the top with one center knob. Under it three gold bars join on a central upright, plus a single jade gem in the lower-right gap. Tiny boy discovers the gem.

胸.memory: Ribs sit alongside a small clasp wrapped around a cross.
胸.visual: A slim rectangular chest panel with two bars on left. On right a broad hook encloses a narrow U with a clear crossed clasp inside. Boy holds a hand over his chest to echo its meaning.

砂.memory: A rock crumbles into a few falling grains.
砂.visual: A slanted stone ledge and square rock form left component. On right a narrow upright between two separate sand beads tops a long diagonal spill down left. Boy catches grains in a tiny pail.

尊.memory: A sacred vessel is handled with care.
尊.visual: Two tilted cap marks and a rail frame a squared ceremonial jar with two interior curves. Beneath, a rail crosses one tall hook with a little bead at lower left. Boy lifts the jar with both hands.

幼.memory: A small folded ribbon is lifted by a strong little lever.
幼.visual: Left is one small golden ribbon with two folds and tiny offset point. Right is a stout hooked toy lever and an angled leg. Tiny boy plays next to the lever.

捨.memory: A hand sets an unwanted box under a shelter.
捨.visual: Tall upright hand rail on left. Right stack a peaked cap over an earth-like cross and one square cubby. Boy places a crumpled paper in the cubby.

乳.memory: A hand above a child pours milk into a curling bowl.
乳.visual: Left put three little fingertips above a small seated child whose arms make a horizontal line. Right an upright cream stream curls up at its foot to hold a drop. Boy watches from below the hand.

紅.memory: Crimson thread stretches over a simple spool stand.
紅.visual: Folded skein and three little trailing ends on left, all vivid crimson. At right a bright upright spool stand has one short top bar and a longer matching foot, joined by one stem.

冊.memory: A string binds upright slats in a single book.
冊.visual: Give four separate upright wooden book slats a single strong horizontal red cord through their centers. Let two outer slats curve inward at the bottom. Boy holds the volume from its lower corner.

卵.memory: Two halves of a nest each hold an egg.
卵.visual: Two bold upright curled nest ribbons stand side by side, with an angled crest on left and a square crest on right. Put one small white egg inside each. Boy tiptoes at the edge.

干.memory: Two rails let wet cloth dry in the sun.
干.visual: Two horizontal cloth-drying rails joined by a single centered upright reaching below the lower bar. Put a tiny drying cloth on one end only. Keep the two rail lengths clear.

拝.memory: A raised hand greets a ceremonial stand.
拝.visual: At left an upright greeting hand has two short projecting fingertips. At right four short bars intersect one centered vertical post. The boy bows from the lower left.

棒.memory: Wood supports a pole under a crossed canopy.
棒.visual: Left is a tall 木 tree. Right five distinct short bars cross a straight pole; near the middle two diagonal braces fan outward. The boy balances the long pole from its base.

蒸.memory: Steam rises from four embers toward leafy herbs.
蒸.visual: Stack two tufts of grass, a broad steamer with a central hook and fanning white steam, and exactly four separate low orange ember marks. Mascot lifts one tiny herb at the margin.

詞.memory: Spoken words emerge from a hooked booth.
詞.visual: Stack simple speech bars and a square mouth on left. On right a long top rail drops into a right hook; inside it a short bar sits above one square sound opening. Boy speaks into the left opening.

机.memory: Two bent feet make a wooden desk.
机.visual: Left is one stout tree with an open trunk. Right a wide top blends into two legs visible from the front, right leg curling upward. Boy puts a tiny book on the desk corner.

灰.memory: Ash sits beneath a cold slanting cover.
灰.visual: A strong top ledge slopes downward left. Under it centered gray ashes form a tapered flame silhouette with two separate gray flecks either side. Boy inspects the cooled pile.

欧.memory: A map with a crossing path sits beside a visitor.
欧.visual: An open-right map border encloses a large crossed path on left. On the right a little traveler bows forward, with a short angled upper accent, crossed shoulders and long splayed legs. No national flags or labels.

被.memory: One garment is covered by a hanging hide.
被.visual: At left a narrow embroidered coat has a short top accent and two sleeve marks. On the right a leather hide hangs from a hooked beam and crosses itself in two big folds. Boy pulls the coat from beneath an edge.

含.memory: A roof holds a little opening inside its folded lip.
含.visual: Small peaked cover above a centered dot and an angled lower fold. Directly below, one square mouth opening holds a tiny seed. Boy reaches only toward that opening.

況.memory: Water surrounds a figure with a big square mouth.
況.visual: Left is three drops. On right a single square face opening stands on two visibly separate downward legs, the right one hooked. Boy sizes up the situation at the side.

湾.memory: Water follows a coast curled like a bow.
湾.visual: Three separate drops at left. At right a short dotted cap over hanging coastal reeds sits above a broad blue open curve with a distinct hooked end. Boy floats a tiny boat inside its curve.

捜.memory: A hand opens a divided panel and searches below.
捜.visual: Tall hand at left. Right is a divided square window crossed by one vertical stem, with two broad ribbons in an X under it. Boy peers through the window.

超.memory: A runner goes past a sign with a square mouth.
超.visual: At left an earth marker over a long splayed running foot descends to a baseline that sweeps across the bottom. At upper right a curling cap tips over one square opening. Boy races past it.

療.memory: A care shelter holds a warm light and a few drops.
parts: wings over sun and small marks (尞)
療.visual: A sloping roof and two distinct side dots wrap top and left. Inside, a slanted canopy covers a rectangular light with one stripe and three small healing sparks below. Boy rests at the edge.

介.memory: A wide roof shelters two separate uprights.
介.visual: Make a strong paired sloping roof above two separated narrow pillars. The left pillar slants outward at its foot and the right pillar stays straight. Boy stands between them.

販.memory: A shell purse opens beside a crossed market stand.
販.visual: A tall shell with two strong inside bars and two splayed supports stands left. At right a long top stall ledge sweeps down left above two crossed beams. Boy places one coin on the tiny counter.

幅.memory: A rectangle of cloth measures the width of its frame.
幅.visual: Left is a hanging cloth with a broad top and clear center seam. Right is a small cap above square neck and a wide four-pane bottom. Boy holds a tape across its width near the base.

般.memory: A narrow boat carries things past a hinged stand.
般.visual: On left a long bent hull with a pointed tip and two small deck strokes. On right a squared bent stand above two strongly crossed supports. Boy sorts two tiny parcels on the boat.

換.memory: A hand trades a parcel under a two-legged stall.
換.visual: Slim tall hand left. Right stack a bent cap over a square frame whose center divides in two and whose legs sweep outward. Boy exchanges one tiny parcel under the stall.

占.memory: A short marker rises above a little fortune box.
占.visual: Stack one tall peg with a small right-facing branch above a single bold square fortune box. Boy lifts one tiny blank fortune slip from its right edge.

伸.memory: A person stretches a post through the center of a frame.
伸.visual: Boy at left forms a narrow standing silhouette. Right put one upright gold pole through a small square panel, crossing its middle horizontal divider, and extending visibly out of the top and bottom.

爆.memory: A flame pops beside a tower with scattered sparks.
爆.visual: On left an orange flame and two separate sparks. On right stack a square light, two rails crossed by pegs, and small radiating pops below. Boy watches a harmless colorful festival spark burst.

普.memory: A square sun shines below things lined up in a row.
普.visual: At top two short slopes over a rail, then two narrow stacks set on a shared base. Below place one square yellow light with a clear middle line. Boy admires the whole row at once.

齢.memory: Teeth beside a little tag tell someone's age.
齢.visual: Left show a top bite mark above a square jaw frame containing a few white teeth. Right a peaked roof covers a small dot and one folded tag. Boy counts ages with tiny tokens near the bottom.

了.memory: A single curled ribbon comes to its end.
了.visual: One large orange ribbon forms a horizontal upper cap then bends down into a single long hook. Boy ties the very end in a tiny bow without changing its outline.

患.memory: Worry threads straight through two boxes into the heart.
患.visual: Two aligned square beads pierced by one bold vertical line dominate the top. Below, a red heart sits between two tiny dots. Boy hugs it gently from the lower edge.

絡.memory: A thread twines around the path over a doorway.
絡.visual: Red folded thread with three ends at left. Right a clearly crossed path under a small angled cap and over one square doorway. One strand twines around the path, with the boy keeping it taut.

募.memory: A sign over the sun calls people to pull together.
募.visual: Two grass tufts above a divided sun and splayed legs form the top. Place a distinct hooked lifting lever below. Boy calls a small friend to help pull it. No lettering.

昇.memory: A square sun rises while a small lift goes up.
昇.visual: Place a large square sun with one divider at top. Below it two thin uprights cross a horizontal bar with a short angled mark above. Boy lifts one small platform toward the sun.

香.memory: Grain gives off a pleasant smell above a warm tile.
香.visual: Stack a full grain stalk with broad crossing boughs on top and one square amber heating tile with single inner bar below. Boy smells a tiny fragrant wisp from the side.

巨.memory: A huge open frame has a little square bay on its upright.
巨.visual: Build a tall upright on the left with long top and bottom beams extending right like an open-sided wooden frame. Halfway up, attach a short closed rectangular storage bay to that same left upright. The bay shares the upright as its left wall and has its own short top, right and bottom walls. Leave clear gaps above and below the bay. The boy stands tiny outside to give scale.

震.memory: Rain hangs above the ground as its layers shake.
震.visual: Top is a four-drop rain canopy with a centered stem. Beneath, a rock shelf slopes down to the left above two horizontal layers and low, splayed earth paths. Boy notices small wobble marks beside the base.

触.memory: A curved horn touches the edge of a boxy insect.
触.visual: At left a hooked horn cap joins a square divided base. At right a boxy insect on a stem has a low stroke bending right and an offset dot. The tips make gentle contact; boy points.

依.memory: A person leans on a coat that shelters them.
依.visual: Boy stands narrow at left, leaning slightly right. On the right a broad coat begins with a cap dot and shoulder rail then opens into two crossing folds and long splayed hems. Boy catches the sleeve for support.

籍.memory: Bamboo binds a register beside the fields.
籍.visual: Two bamboo tips on top. Beneath left a rake shaft crosses several short marks and ends in two tines. Beneath right two pegs cross a rail over one divided square record tile. Boy fits a blank bamboo slip in the register.

汚.memory: Splashes fall beside a stained hooked trough.
汚.visual: Three separated murky drops at left. On right two short horizontal lines sit over a wide trough with a single downturned hook. One brown stain sits inside the trough. Mascot reaches for a little cloth.

傾.memory: A person leans toward a tilted page.
傾.visual: Boy stands left in a narrow silhouette. Right place a tiny curved bracket alongside a tall page with top tag, two interior bars and two feet. Tilt the page slightly toward the boy.

跡.memory: A footprint leads past a sign with marks on both sides.
跡.visual: At left a small square tile tops a supported foot sloping downward. At right a dotted cap and rail have two dangling short posts and one distinct stepped mark on each side. Boy follows a tiny trail beside the base.

駐.memory: A horse stops beside the main post.
