駐.visual: Big boxy wooden pony on left with ridged side and four small hoof marks. Right a tall post crosses three rails with one separate cap dot. Boy brings the pony to a gentle stop.

紹.memory: A thread connects an introduction to a new friend.
紹.visual: Folded red thread at left with three loose ends. At right a bent cap sits on a large square puppet mouth. Boy lifts one end to connect the two as the puppet waves.

雇.memory: A bird helper arrives under a door.
雇.visual: A separate top lintel above a small slanting roof wraps the top and left. Place a tall boxy bird with four short wing bars directly underneath. Boy welcomes the bird helper from the edge.

替.memory: Two frames trade places over a square marker.
替.visual: Stack two upright frames with swept feet and two short rails each. Under the pair center one large square day tile with a horizontal stripe. Boy slides one small marker in and another out.

贈.memory: A shell waits beside a stack of gifts.
贈.visual: Left a tall shell with two bars and two separated feet. Right place two top ribbons above one square gift box with four panes, stacked on a smaller square box with one divider. Boy presents it.

薄.memory: Grass shelters a tiny flow beside a narrow patch.
薄.visual: Two leafy accents above the full picture. Below put three drops at left and a narrow divided square tile with a protruding peg and tiny top-right dot. Under the tile place a short hooked measuring post. Boy lifts a thin tile.

奥.memory: A deep window is held high above a broad figure.
奥.visual: A narrow square almost closed chamber with one top accent encloses a star of grains. Beneath it a stylized figure spreads both arms and legs widely like 大. Boy leans toward the back of the chamber.

詰.memory: Spoken directions pack things into a square cubby.
詰.visual: Speech bars and square speaker left. On right a short cross and rail above a larger separate square cubby. Boy packs one box into the cubby, keeping its square border visible.

双.memory: Two matching crossed ribbons make a pair.
双.visual: Exactly two equal golden hand ribbons sit next to each other. Each has a short upper cap with one down-left sweep crossed by one distinct diagonal down-right sweep. Boy holds their tips apart.

刺.memory: A thorny frame stands beside two signs with pointed tips.
刺.visual: Left one upright stem with a horizontal branch through an open-bottom square, two sweeping pointed roots below. At right two slim upright silver spikes, tall one curling at its bottom. Boy points with a tiny magnifier.

悩.memory: A heart worries beside a frame of tangled thoughts.
悩.visual: At left one red upright stem with two heart marks. At right three separated sparks hover above a bold U-shaped frame holding a crossed ribbon. The boy untangles the ribbon gently.

荒.memory: Grass covers a weathered sign and branching streams.
荒.visual: Two grass shoots along the top. Beneath place a top dot and angled open hook over three separated vertical trails, outer two curved. Boy discovers a wild sprout near one of the trails.

硬.memory: A stone stays hard as two beams cross beneath the sun.
硬.visual: At left a stone ledge slopes down to one square rock. On right a wide top cap covers one divided sun window above two big intersecting beams. Boy taps the rock.

埋.memory: A patch of earth holds a grid covered below.
埋.visual: A short earth cross at left. Right is a four-pane square field with an upright running through two broad rails underneath. Boy buries a tiny seed in the lower shelf.

袋.memory: A carried strap sits over a coat-shaped sack.
袋.visual: Top tier has a narrow upright boy on left and a long hooked shoulder strap on right. Below both, a cloth sack fans out into two broad folded hems, with one central drawstring and a low left hook.

封.memory: Two piles of earth sit beside a hook that closes them.
封.visual: Left stack two earth crosses on the same stem. Right a tall hook crosses a rail with one dot offset lower left. Boy presses a small clay seal at the edge.

賢.memory: A watchful eye and hand guard a shell of knowledge.
賢.visual: At top left a square watchful eye in an upright panel; at top right two crossing hand ribbons. Center a boxy shell with two inside bars and two legs beneath both. Boy looks thoughtfully at it.

腕.memory: An arm bends around a bent clasp under a roof.
腕.visual: Left one tall rounded arm panel with two stripes. At right a small roof above two contours: a short slanting crescent at left and a large curled hook at right. Boy folds his forearm along the curve.

床.memory: A tree-shaped wooden bed fits beneath a shelter.
床.visual: A large roof extends across top and down left. Beneath it center a bed frame with upright beam, two branches and splayed feet in a 木 arrangement. Boy tucks in a cushion beside the branches.

柔.memory: A pliable wooden stem bends under a curled ribbon.
柔.visual: An angular curl with a small horizontal bar and a short diagonal sweep rests high above a large 木-like tree. Boy bends one thin branch gently; both components remain visible.

殿.memory: Two supporters hold the roof of a tall hall.
殿.visual: Left a slanting upper roof shelters a square hall on two feet with two crossbars. Right a matching high stand with curved legs sits above two crossed broad supports. Boy visits the gate.

濃.memory: Thick drops gather beside a layered seed tray.
濃.visual: Three large drops at left in a tall column. Right a divided seed box with two protruding uprights is stacked over a cliff and spread furrows. A tiny drop slowly hangs from one corner of the tray.

肩.memory: A door-shaped yoke rests over a shaped rib panel.
肩.visual: A horizontal lintel sits above a narrow boxy yoke sweeping down at left. Directly below it a tall rounded blue panel with two short bands rests near the boy's shoulder.

零.memory: Rain falls over a small clear marker that has no drops left.
零.visual: Stack a broad cap with four visible rain drops above a narrow peaked roof, central dot and angled folded seal. Boy holds a little empty container at the edge.

泊.memory: Three drops mark a white guesthouse beside water.
泊.visual: Three calm drops on left. On right a square white lit guesthouse window with one central divider and one small slanted crest. Boy sets a tiny travel bag beneath it for the night.

甘.memory: A sweet tray has one bar through the middle.
甘.visual: Make a chunky squared honey tray in front view with two pegs extending above a wide rim. One neat interior horizontal bar and a low closure form the rest. Boy tastes one small drop at the side.

掃.memory: A hand guides a broom beneath its cover.
掃.visual: At left an upright hand with two short projecting fingers. At right stack a folded broom head, a broad shelter rail and a hanging three-section brush. Boy sweeps one little leaf.

掘.memory: A hand digs out two terraces underneath a cliff.
掘.visual: Left has a long upright hand shape. Right a roof ledge slopes down on the left around two stacked three-prong earth terraces. Boy lifts a small piece of soil from the upper one.

軟.memory: A soft cover bends beside a square cart.
軟.visual: A square wagon with two cross rails and tall central axle stands left. On right a loose fabric figure has a short bent top and two splayed soft folds. Boy squishes one edge beside the cart.

沈.memory: Drops fall as a hooked shape sinks beneath a rail.
沈.visual: Left three separated blue drops. Right a broad shallow cover rail crosses a vertical marker that bends out into two legs below, one low right hook. The boy watches the marker dip beneath a narrow water line.

凍.memory: Two ice marks chill a tree with a boxed middle.
凍.visual: Place exactly two broad blue ice marks at left. Right one upright trunk crosses a wide bar and rectangular box with four sections, then splits into long diagonal feet. Frost rests only on the visible parts.

恋.memory: A tiny signal sits above a warm heart.
恋.visual: At top a short dot and rail cap with two clear upright hangers and two outward sparks. Beneath, a centered red heart with two little reflected dots. Boy holds a ribbon at its edge.

郊.memory: Crossing roads meet a gate at the edge of town.
郊.visual: Left a dotted cap and rail top two crossing paths that taper into an X. Right one slim gatepost with a rounded small curl. Boy walks out toward a single tuft beyond the gate.

腰.memory: A body mark shows where a belt wraps around the waist.
腰.visual: Left a tall blue body panel with two clean interior bars. At right a shallow gridded belt above an adult figure whose arms and crossed legs make 女. Boy measures the belt from its side.

踊.memory: A dancing foot taps beside a tunnel-shaped beat box.
踊.visual: Left stack a small square over a wide slanted dancing foot. Right a bent tab over a square box with one central shaft and at least two clear crossbars. Boy taps one foot between the pieces.

珍.memory: A tiny rare gem comes from a shape under three ribbons.
珍.visual: At left three short jade rails joined by an upright. At right a broad peaked cover shelters three short parallel gold ribbons sweeping down-left. Boy discovers one tiny gem on the lowest sweep.

喫.memory: A mouth eats a little treat beside its marked parcel.
喫.visual: Big square mouth on left, with soft friendly cheeks. Right stack a tied bundle with three rails and a curved tab above a long crossing shelf with spread feet. Boy takes one bite of a cracker at the edge.

溶.memory: Water dissolves a crystal under a roof over a valley.
溶.visual: At left three blue drops. Right stack a small roof, two pairs of angled slopes opening inward, and a square basin at the foot. Show a little sugar cube softening inside the basin.

涙.memory: Drops spill as a little figure opens a door.
涙.visual: At far left three bold blue tears. On right put an upper lintel and door corner above a large figure with arms and legs spread. Boy holds a tiny handkerchief to the side.

匹.memory: A small animal fits on two legs inside a wide pen.
匹.visual: A bold rectangular pen is open to the right. Inside put a friendly tiny animal whose two prominent legs splay out, right one curled. Boy counts it from outside without any numerals.

鋭.memory: Metal comes to a precise point beside an open stand.
鋭.visual: At left a triangular ingot cover and short rails. At right two distinct slanted top tabs above a single boxlike mouth and two clear legs. A tiny gleam on the peaked top shows sharpness; boy points from the margin.

塗.memory: Water and a brush lay color onto the ground.
塗.visual: Upper left is a trio of blue drops. Upper right a peaked roof above three horizontal brush rails and tiny splayed tips. Below both sits a broad earth cross that the boy coats in a stripe of paint.

軒.memory: A cart stops beside two rails under the eaves.
軒.visual: Left a square wagon seen from above with two rails and extended axle. Right one tall post holds two horizontal beams, broad upper one forming the eave. Boy parks underneath.

叫.memory: A square mouth shouts toward two hooked listening posts.
叫.visual: At left a bold squared speaking mouth. At right two narrow upright prongs, left one angled into the other with a small hook. Boy calls toward the prongs as tiny sparks of sound.

乾.memory: Sun dries the frame beside a hooked clothesline.
乾.visual: On left a square sun with an internal stripe sits between two small cross posts. On right an angled notch above a large hooked clothesline. Boy sets a tiny towel on the hook.

祈.memory: A small altar stands beside a wooden prayer fixture.
祈.visual: Left small upright altar with separate top dot and little offset marks. Right a slanting bracket meets a short rail and a long vertical post. Boy brings hands together in front of the stand; no religious text.

汗.memory: Drops fall beside a two-bar exercise post.
汗.visual: Exactly three big drops at left. At right one upright post crosses two horizontal bars. Boy fans himself after exercise, leaving all three drops and two bars readable.

湿.memory: Drops gather below a sun tile on a slatted base.
湿.visual: Left column of three drops, right a divided square sunlight tile above two short upright rails and a broad low platform with tiny side marks. Boy lifts one damp tile.

瓶.memory: A tied rack holds a bottle by its curled foot.
瓶.visual: Left two top slanted tips over two rails crossed by uprights. Right a square bottle shape has a long top cap, curled right foot and one single central round mark. Boy sets it next to the rack.

咲.memory: A smiling square mouth calls to a flower opening.
咲.visual: A small square smiling mouth to the left. On the right two top petals float over two broad branches crossing a single stem, ending in two sweeping roots. Boy cheers the open flower from below.

召.memory: A bent megaphone calls out through a square mouth.
召.visual: Stack a bent megaphone handle with a short straight cap and curved right edge over a big square puppet mouth. Boy calls in one small cheerful burst from the side.

缶.memory: A capped container has a tall center handle and three ridges.
缶.visual: Give a stout ceramic can a clipped diagonal top and two rails crossed by one upright. The bottom is one connected U with a center stem. Boy taps the lid.

隻.memory: A bird sits above a crossed pair of waves.
隻.visual: Stack a slim upright bird with four bold wing marks over two crossing wave ribbons, one with a short flat cap. Boy holds a tiny wooden boat at the edge of the crossed waves.

脂.memory: A body panel stands by a little jar of cooking fat.
脂.visual: Left is a tall light body panel with two clear stripes. Right a bent hook with a slanting top sits above a square yellow jar with a center division. Boy puts a tiny lid on the jar.

肌.memory: A smooth body panel stands next to a curved little stand.
肌.visual: At left a pale rounded rectangle with two subtle inner bars, soft blush shading. At right a small flat cap bends down into two slender legs, right leg curling up. Boy feels one smooth edge.

鈍.memory: Metal meets a blunt curved tip.
鈍.visual: A triangular cap and stack of metal bars at left. At right an upright blunt peg descends through a broad crossbar and curls up into a thick rounded foot. The boy holds a little shiny stone.

泥.memory: Water collects under a ledge and curls into mud.
泥.visual: Three brown-blue drops at left. Right a wide roof ledge slopes down-left while one wide low mud track inside curls upward on the right. Boy lifts a muddy boot near the far edge.

隅.memory: A cliff meets a squared figure tucked into a corner.
隅.visual: At left a tall narrow cliff with two ledges. Right a square four-pane mask and broad open-bottom frame with a curled inner tail. Boy points to the bottom corner next to the cliff.

辛.memory: A pepper balanced on a tall sign makes a spicy bite.
辛.visual: Top a tiny knob and squat tabletop with two angled supports. Directly below center a tall crossed pepper post with one bold bar. Boy fans his mouth at the edge of the post.

磨.memory: Two wooden handles grind a stone below a shelter.
磨.visual: One broad top and left roof cover two narrow crossed wood handles side by side. Below the pair put a sloped grinding ledge and single square stone. Boy moves one handle at the edge.

姓.memory: A woman's family name grows like a sprout.
姓.visual: Left an adult woman poses with visibly crossing legs and one wide arm. Right stack three small rails crossing one upright, with one short slant at top, as a sprout sign. Boy waves to her from the margin.

筒.memory: Bamboo covers a tube with a square opening.
筒.visual: Two bamboo tufts across the top. Under them a tall open-bottom gold casing surrounds one short beam and one square tube opening. Boy looks through the tube.

粒.memory: A grain stands out beside an upright stand.
粒.visual: Left arrange rice grains into a vertical star with one crossbar, two upper accents and two splayed roots. Right a small stand with a cap, two angled legs and broad foot. Boy lifts one loose grain.

畳.memory: A four-pane tatami mat folds neatly onto a stand.
畳.visual: Top one golden field mat with exactly four panes. Below it a long low lid caps a square stack with two interior bars and a wide flat foot. Boy carries away a folded corner.

膚.memory: An outer cover shelters a ribbed body shape.
膚.visual: A soft striped overhang wraps top and left. Inside stack a four-section patch over a rounded skin-colored panel with two bars. Boy gently cleans its edge with a cloth.

濯.memory: Water rinses a bird's two feather panels.
濯.visual: Three drops descend along the far left. On the upper right, two matching folded wings sit shoulder to shoulder in one horizontal row, with their tips aligned, a small gap between them and two marks in each wing. One smaller upright bird with four wing stripes is centered directly below the pair. Boy helps rinse the bird near the bottom.

塔.memory: An earth post stands beside a grass-capped tower.
塔.visual: On left a broad earth cross sits on a foot. On right two grass accents above a peaked cap and small square window form a tall tower. Boy looks upward from the ground.

沸.memory: Droplets bubble beside two rails through bent pipes.
沸.visual: At left three large droplets. At right two tall pipes pierce the same squared zigzag coil with its right hook visible. A few tiny bubbles stay inside the coil and the boy looks from the side.

菓.memory: Grass grows above a fruit tree shaped like a candy tray.
菓.visual: Two grazed sprouts along one upper grass bar. Below center a square four-pane tray of fruit sweets attached to a trunk with crossing branches and two splayed roots. Boy takes one candy near the edge.

帽.memory: A cap sits above two panels next to hanging cloth.
帽.visual: A narrow cloth with central pendant seam on left. On right stack a wide soft cap with one short line over a tall rectangular eye panel with two horizontal marks. Boy tries on a tiny matching cap.

枯.memory: A withered tree stands beside an old square sign.
枯.visual: At left a bare tree whose trunk, boughs and roots make a pronounced 木 silhouette. At right a little cross above a square wooden sign opening. Boy touches one drooping leaf.

涼.memory: Water cools the air below a tall pavilion.
涼.visual: Three blue drops at left. Right tiered dotted cap above a square window and three narrow pointing supports, longer in the center. Boy holds a small fan at the edge.

舟.memory: A narrow boat shows its ribs from above.
舟.visual: Show a compact wooden boat tilted upright, with a short slant at top, two long hull edges and broad cross rail. Two small separate deck marks sit inside. Boy pilots it from the lower side.

符.memory: A bamboo token is given beside a measuring hook.
符.visual: Two clearly separated bamboo clusters on top. Lower half has a slim standing boy on left, a long hook crossed by rail and little dot on right. Boy passes one small blank bamboo token to the hook.

憎.memory: An upset heart sits beside a stack of angry marks.
憎.visual: A red upright heart stem with two short separated marks on left. Right place two small slanted marks above a rectangular four-pane block with a smaller square divided block directly below it. Boy frowns at a harmless spilled puzzle.

肯.memory: A solid footstep sits above a body with a nod.
肯.visual: A stepped shape crosses a broad flat rail in upper half. Beneath it center a tall rounded body tile with two short interior lines. Boy nods as he steps onto the upper platform.

燥.memory: A fire dries three little boxes over wood.
燥.visual: Left is one fire shape with two separated side sparks. Right exactly three squared drying crates form a one-over-two pyramid above a wooden stem with branches and roots. Boy lifts out one tiny dry leaf.

畜.memory: A folded lead hangs above four fenced animal pens.
畜.visual: A small cap with a top dot rests over a low folded rope loop and one offset mark. Beneath it a square pen has four plots with one tiny animal each. Boy checks the rope from the margin.

挟.memory: A hand pinches the gap in a wide set of crossed jaws.
挟.visual: Left tall wrist has two short projecting fingers. At right show a broad crossed clamp centered around one long rail, with two small dashes inside. Boy pinches a soft paper scrap between the jaws.

曇.memory: A square sun is hidden behind rain and curled clouds.
曇.visual: Top one square sun with clear center line. Center a broad rain canopy with center stem and four drops. Along the bottom place two short stripes and one large curled cloud. Boy looks up at the sun's edge.

滴.memory: Drops fall beside a layered spout that drips.
滴.visual: Three detached blue droplets down left. Right a small dotted roof with two angled supports above a tall square casing containing a single square spout. One tiny extra drip falls inside the casing below the spout.

伺.memory: A person asks a question at a hooked service window.
伺.visual: At left a single upright boy with slanting shoulder and straight leg asks a question. Right a large rail turns down into a hook on far right; tucked within are a short bar and one clear square window.
